text:
Your attraction problem isn't women. It's you.

You think she won't respond because she's picky. Wrong. She won't respond because you haven't earned interest. You're one of 20 guys saying the same thing.

She smells weakness.

Real attraction starts when you stop needing her. It starts when you have something going.

Make money. Get stronger. Dress better. Stop texting first. Stop acting like she's special before meeting her.

Stop being the one who needs. Become the one she needs.
caption:
Your problem with women isn't women. It's that you haven't fixed yourself.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
#discipline #mindset #selfimprovement #dating #mensgrowth
